name: R POLYCENTRIC CITYWEAVE
purpose: Human eye public room hypotheses tied to intended mixed-use city, without enforcing simplistic 3D macro-forms
coordinate_system: right_handed; x lateral, y forward, z up; metres; hypothetical
proof_level: not geometry; all physical, visual, structural checks NOT RUN

camera.validation: confirm actual ray/mesh floor under camera, not spline elevation

program_thresholds.activity: goods counters, vendor work, browsing within deep room
active making tables, workshop edge, crafts
shelving, desks, real occupied reading zone

checks: All three thresholds visible simultaneously from one true 1.7m above floor S1 perspective, not just labels
Actual openings and deep room volumes; two opaque-wall negative rays in addition to open paths
Daylight enters from physically open overhead and lateral apertures without relying on impossible sunlight
Recognizable human scale with occupancy/activity without staged labels

design_requirements: district boundaries are inhabited mixed-use transition spaces
more than one independent elevation of lived-in public connections
large skyline outline emerges from overlapping occupied neighborhoods not 3 towers and thin bridges
no dominating single roof, canyon, slab, diagonal ramp, empty arch or grid frame
visible outdoor daylight pockets and resident routes, with human-readable streets and rooms
same built S1 public heart traceable within distant oblique scene
city_topology.note: Not a generator input: spatial composition must be artist-designed

invariants.all: unchanged; validate exact historic meaning at G2/G3; values not evaluated by this file
